Respondents** _Corrigendum to the order dated 24.3.2022 in Petition No. 452/MP/2019 Page_ **_2_** _of_ **_8_** the guidelines dated 2.1.2015 issued by Ministry of Coal. The Commission vide order dated 24.3.2022 in Petition No. 452/MP/2019, trued up the lignite transfer price in respect of the lignite mines of NLCIL for the period 2014-19. 2. It has come to the notice of the Commission that certain clerical and arithmetical mistakes and errors arising from accidental slip or omission have occurred in order dated 24.3.2022 in Petition No. 452/MP/2019 on account of inadvertent exclusion of third party sales of Mine 1A against O&M, Over-Burden and total pooled mine cost for the period 2014-15 to 2018-19. 3. Regulation 103 A of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999 as amended from time to time (hereinafter referred to as CBR) provides for the amendment of orders, in case of clerical or arithmetical mistakes or errors on account of accidental slip or omission. Regulation 103 A of CBR is extracted below: 103A. Clerical or arithmetical mistakes in the orders or errors arising therein from any accidental slip or omission may at any time be corrected by the Commission either of its own motion or on the application of any of the parties.” 4. In exercise of power under Regulation 103A of CBR, the Commission hereby issues the following corrigenda to order dated 24.3.2022 in Petition No. 452/MP/2019: - (a) In first sentence of para 44, the word “not” shall be inserted before the word “necessary”. - (b) In second sentence of para 44, the words “after excluding the expenses attributable to outside sales/third party sales” shall be deleted. - (c) The rows at serial numbers B, C, D and E of the Table below para 44 shall be deleted. _Corrigendum to the order dated 24.3.2022 in Petition No. 452/MP/2019 Page_ **_3_** _of_ **_8_** - (d) In para 45, the words in the bracket, namely, “excluding O&M expenses attributable to outside sales/third party sales” shall be deleted. - (j) In para 53, the words “excluding O&M expenses attributable to outside sales/third party sales from pooled Mine 1A” shall be deleted. _Corrigendum to the order dated 24.3.2022 in Petition No. 452/MP/2019 Page_ **_4_** _of_ **_8_** _Corrigendum to the order dated 24.3.2022 in Petition No. 452/MP/2019 Page_ **_5_** _of_ **_8_** _Corrigendum to the order dated 24.3.2022 in Petition No. 452/MP/2019 Page_ **_6_** _of_ **_8_** _Corrigendum to the order dated 24.3.2022 in Petition No. 452/MP/2019 Page_ **_7_** _of_ **_8_** **_Sd/- Sd/- Sd/- Sd/-_ (Pravas Kumar Singh) (Arun Goyal) (I.S.
